claims.text: It serves as a recurring motivational call to action, urging listeners to commit their energy and effort toward collective goals (L5, L16).

The concept of 'doing the work' is consistently associated with positive outcomes, such as building community and making sure that a community is enjoyable (L1, L2, L6). It implies active commitment and effort, which are necessary for growth and change (L5, L11, L13, L16).
